commit_message:
feat: add frame encode/decode

Also document the error type and re-export the public API.
summary: Protocol frame codec (RFC 6455 header) across several files, with doc-only distractor edits in error.rs and mask.rs. Tests cover the 7-bit and 16-bit length forms but never the boundaries, the 64-bit form, masked decoding, or the size limit.

defects.description: No test sits on a length-form boundary (125/126, 65535/65536), and nothing exercises the 64-bit form (> 65535 bytes), so `len < 126` -> `<= 126`, `len <= 0xffff` -> `<`, and errors in the 127 branch survive. This is wire encoding, so it is high risk; golden header bytes at 125, 126, 65535 and 65536 are needed.

`masked_payload_differs_on_the_wire` only asserts the masked bytes differ from the payload; no test decodes a masked frame or pins the masked bytes. Wrong key indexing (`i % 4` -> `i % 3`), skipping the unmask in decode, or the mask bit being dropped all survive. A roundtrip of a masked frame plus golden masked bytes are needed.

The MAX_PAYLOAD check (`len > MAX_PAYLOAD` / FrameError::TooLarge) is never tested, and `rejects_truncated_input` uses only is_err(), so the `needed` counts in every Truncated error (and truncation inside the extended-length or mask-key fields) are unpinned. Tests should assert_eq! exact errors, including TooLarge for a 127-form header declaring MAX_PAYLOAD + 1.
